name: BENCH: Command: Skeletal Rogue (504318) on a lone Skeletal Rogue kill, necromancer never swings
contract: SoloKill.RequirePlayerHit (#10365) gives an ungrouped player XP/loot only if they 'hit' the creature (Creature::AddDirectPlayerAttacker). Command orders go through Order() (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:405) and may not register as a hit. This probes, on unfixed main, whether a creature killed solely by a Skeletal Rogue (50078, raised by Raise: Skeletal Rogue 500969, cost 1 Life Force) under Command: Skeletal Rogue 504318 gives the necromancer experience when the necromancer never swings or casts at the target.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
SETUP: the Skeletal Rogue is raised
Clear the global cooldown after summoning
Command: Skeletal Rogue on the target
SETUP: the Skeletal Rogue kills the target
BENCH: the necromancer gets experience from a Command kill it never swung at
The necromancer's level did not change
